maddeler.e:
ننجبر (form VII)
# نَنْجَبِرُ (nanjabiru) /nan.d͡ʒa.bi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# نَنْجَبِرَ (nanjabira) /nan.d͡ʒa.bi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# نَنْجَبِرْ (nanjabir) /nan.d͡ʒa.bir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
